cd /workspace/scratch && cat > exp7.py <<'EOF'
import sys, random, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/scratch'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import gen_big, model as M, analyze as AN
import z3
rng = random.Random(1)
req = gen_big.build(rng, tight=False)
inst = AN._parse_request(req)
m = M.build(inst)
base = m['base']; q = m['q']; n = m['n']
target = n[1][4]

def to_real(e):
    return e

# 1) LP relaxation: replace integer vars by Real
o = z3.Optimize()
for a in base:
    o.add(z3.substitute(a, []))
# rebuild with Real variables
qr = [[z3.Real('rq_%d_%d' % (s, c)) for c in range(m['C'])] for s in range(m['S'])]
nr = [[z3.Real('rn_%d_%d' % (s, e)) for e in range(m['E'])] for s in range(m['S'])]
sub = {}
for s in range(m['S']):
    for c in range(m['C']):
        sub[q[s][c]] = qr[s][c]
    for e in range(m['E']):
        sub[n[s][e]] = nr[s][e]
rbase = [z3.substitute(a, [(v, sub[v]) for v in [a] ] if False else list(sub.items())) for a in base]
rbase = [z3.substitute(a, list(sub.items())) for a in base]
o = z3.Optimize(); o.add(*rbase)
h = o.minimize(sub[target])
t0=time.time(); r=o.check(); print('LP relax %.2f %s %s' % (time.time()-t0, r, o.lower(h)), flush=True)

# 2) integer: check target <= v for v near the known optimum 213780
pbeq = z3.PbEq([(b,1) for b in m['bvars']], 13)
for v in (213780, 213779, 213000, 200000):
    s = z3.Solver(); s.add(*base); s.add(pbeq); s.add(target <= v)
    t0=time.time(); r=s.check(); print('sat <=%d %.2f %s' % (v, time.time()-t0, r), flush=True)
EOF
